title: Thirupparankundram: Nainar Nagenthran detained, protests erupt over deepam

ai.summary: Protests erupted in Tamil Nadu after the Karthigai Maha Deepam was lit at the Uchipillaiyar Temple instead of the disputed Deepathoon pillar, leading to detentions of BJP leaders.

facts.claim: Karthigai Maha Deepam was lit at the Uchipillaiyar Temple instead of the disputed Deepathoon pillar
facts.quote: the Karthigai Maha Deepam was lit at the customary Deepa Mandapam near the Uchipillaiyar Temple instead of the disputed Deepathoon pillar

ai.background_note: The Tamil Nadu government is not complying with Madras High Court orders on lighting the Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankundram Hill, leading to protests across the state.
